cases.name: Workspace creation with VNet integration
cases.input: Create a new Azure ML workspace with VNet integration and managed network isolation in the eastus region.
expected_behaviors: Provides the az ml workspace create command with --public-network-access Disabled and --managed-network flags
Explains the three managed network modes: Disabled, AllowInternetOutbound, AllowOnlyApprovedOutbound
Mentions --image-build-compute for ACR image builds behind a VNet
References the workspace resource hierarchy (storage, key vault, ACR, App Insights)
Advises on private DNS zones required for managed network isolation
should_not: Create a workspace without explaining the networking implications of disabling public access
Omit the image-build-compute requirement when using managed network isolation

cases.name: Compute cluster provisioning
cases.input: Provision a GPU compute cluster for training with A100 GPUs that auto-scales from 0 to 4 nodes.
expected_behaviors: Provides the az ml compute create command for AmlCompute with --min-instances 0 and --max-instances 4
Recommends an appropriate GPU SKU (e.g., Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4 for single GPU, Standard_ND96amsr_A100_v4 for multi-GPU)
Explains idle-time-before-shutdown to control when the cluster scales down
Mentions that the cluster needs proper VNet/subnet placement if the workspace uses managed networking
Notes that quota must be available for the selected VM family in the target region
should_not: Recommend a CPU-only SKU when the user explicitly requested GPUs
Set min-instances above 0 without explaining the cost implication of always-on clusters

cases.name: Private endpoint configuration
cases.input: Set up private endpoints for my Azure ML workspace so that all traffic stays within the VNet.
expected_behaviors: Lists the required private DNS zones (privatelink.api.azureml.ms, privatelink.blob.core.windows.net, etc.)
Provides az network private-endpoint create commands for the workspace and dependent resources
Explains the relationship between private endpoints, private DNS zones, and DNS resolution
Mentions that ACR requires Premium SKU for private endpoint support
References the networking.md reference file for full VNet configuration details
should_not: Suggest using public endpoints alongside private endpoints for the same service
Omit the private DNS zone configuration, which is required for name resolution

cases.name: Managed identity setup
cases.input: Configure managed identities so my compute cluster can access the workspace storage account and ACR.
expected_behaviors: Explains the difference between system-assigned and user-assigned managed identities
Provides az role assignment create commands for Storage Blob Data Reader on the storage account
Provides ACR pull role assignment for the compute cluster identity
Explains that compute instances and clusters each have their own identity scope
References the identities-acr-storage.md reference file for full RBAC role details
should_not: Recommend using storage account keys instead of managed identities
Assign overly permissive roles like Owner or Contributor when data plane roles suffice

cases.name: Troubleshooting a failed deployment
cases.input: My online endpoint deployment failed with a HealthCheckFailure. How do I diagnose and fix it?
expected_behaviors: Provides az ml online-deployment get-logs command to retrieve container logs
Explains the difference between inference-server logs and storage-initializer logs
Lists common causes: scoring script errors, missing dependencies, health probe misconfiguration, resource limits
Suggests checking the endpoint health endpoint and az ml online-endpoint show for current status
References the troubleshooting.md reference file for the full error reference table and debugging workflow
should_not: Recommend deleting and recreating the endpoint before checking logs
Assume the issue is a networking problem without first examining the container logs
